tagline: Local browser sheet music and tab player with piano fingering and grand piano sound
summary: A Soundslice-style practice player built on alphaTab. It renders notation and tab from Guitar Pro, MusicXML, Capella and alphaTex files. Playback has a moving cursor, looping, speed control, metronome and count-in. Its standout feature is an automatic piano fingering optimizer based on Parncutt's model, which few competitors have. What's missing for a practice tool: MIDI keyboard input with a wait mode, an on-screen keyboard, per-hand practice, transposition, and MIDI file import.

items: Guitar Pro (gp3 to gp7, gpx), MusicXML (xml, mxl), Capella and alphaTex
Library of scores on the server, drag-and-drop, and Save to library
Page and horizontal layouts, zoom, and stave options
Synthesized playback with a moving cursor and auto-scroll
Click to seek, and drag-select a passage to play or loop it
Speed from 25% to 200%, metronome and count-in
Suggested fingering from a dynamic-programming optimizer (Parncutt ergonomic model), with right and left hand colored separately
Uses fingering stored in the file when present
Sampled concert-grand SoundFont, switchable to General MIDI
